title: floorplan.json — canonical property plan (v1)
description: One property, one file. Plan coordinates are in feet, X grows east (right), Y grows north (up the page), origin at the south-west corner of the exterior envelope. Heights are feet above the level's finished floor. The same file drives the stylized 2D plan and the 3D walkthrough.

subtitle.description: e.g. city, or 'Unit D'. Never a street address unless the owner has agreed to publish it.

units.description: v1 is feet only. Store inches as decimals (6" = 0.5).

north.description: Degrees clockwise from +Y to true north. 0 = the top of the page is north.

source.description: How the geometry was obtained. 'listing' = traced from a listing floor plan image.

confidence.description: rough = ±1 ft, measured = ±2 in, surveyed = professional.

attribution.description: Where the source imagery/plan came from, if not shot by the author.

tour.description: Ordered stops for the Docent and the 3D camera. Each stop names a space; the space's own camera is used unless overridden here.

via.description: Waypoints the camera passes through on the way to this stop, in order — put one in each doorway so the path never cuts through a wall.

hold.description: Relative dwell weight for the scroll timeline.

point.description: [x, y] in feet on the plan.

point3.description: [x, y, h]: plan x, plan y, height above finished floor — all feet.

ceiling.description: Default ceiling height for the level, feet.

wall.description: A straight wall segment along its centerline. Split at every corner and at every change of thickness.

thickness.description: Feet. Interior 2x4 wall with drywall ≈ 0.375; exterior ≈ 0.5.

height.description: Override the level ceiling for this wall (half walls, pony walls).

opening.description: A cut in a wall, located by distance along the wall from its 'from' point to the near edge of the opening.

height.description: Head height above floor. Default: door 6.67, window 6.67, cased = ceiling.

sill.description: Bottom of the opening above floor. Windows ≈ 3; doors 0.

swing.description: For doors. 'in' = swings toward the wall's left side when walking from→to; hinge on the left/right edge of the opening as seen from the wall's 'from' end. Read docs/drafting-standards.md before guessing.

polygon.description: Counter-clockwise, to the finished face of the walls (not the centerline).

ceiling.description: Override the level ceiling for this space.

photos.description: Relative paths to capture photos (see capture-protocol). Never checked in above 2 MB each.

fixture.description: A placed object. 'at' is the center of its footprint; 'size' is [width, depth] before rotation.

asset.description: Optional model reference, e.g. 'meshy://<id>' or a path under /public/models. Placeholder boxes are used when absent.
